**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement contains no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant. § 14.8 "Personnel" — the expected location per the planner hint — deals only with each party's supervision of its own staff, IBM's right to assign personnel, and IBM's subcontracting rights. Searches across the full document for "solicit", "hire", "induce", "recruit", "employ" and "personnel" surfaced no hiring restraint (the "employ" hits are all "employees" in definitions and indemnity clauses).

Because our preferred position under NOSOLICIT is *no* non-solicit binding the Customer, the absence of such a clause is the best available outcome for Bluefly rather than a gap to be filled — this is compliant at the preferred level, not "missing".
